units.text: FR-001: May 2027 is the deployment month.
FR-001: Los servicios DEBERÍAN rechazar solicitudes no autorizadas.
FR-001: The service SHOULD reject unauthorized requests.

may-year.label: negative
may-year.reason: The line states a deployment month as a fact; May is part of the date, not a normative MAY permission or obligation.

denial-es.label: positive
denial-es.reason: DEBERÍAN rechazar solicitudes no autorizadas expresa explícitamente una conducta de rechazo, aunque sea recomendada.

denial-en.label: positive
denial-en.reason: SHOULD reject unauthorized requests explicitly states rejection behavior, even though it is phrased as a recommendation.
